therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Intracoronary delivery of unfractionated bone marrow mononuclear cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with recent large acute myocardial infarction
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Difference in change of left ventricular ejection fraction between placebo-treated and cell-treated patients at 90 days; occurrence of arrhythmia, heart failure and death at 1 year

context.indication: acute myocardial infarction with heart failure
context.investigator_commentary: Study never received IRB approval. Study was never pursued.
